description: Where a segment's subtitle is placed on the video, in WebVTT cue-setting notation. Every field is optional; a segment without `cue_settings` uses the position of the subtitle profile. Examples: top left `{"align":"left","line":"8%","position":"5%"}`, bottom center `{"line":"85%"}`. Studio's burn-in and the editor preview place the top of the subtitle box at `line` and the edge picked by `align` at `position`; vertical subtitle profiles ignore the position. Percentages outside 0–100% are clamped to the video when the subtitle is rendered.

line.description: Vertical position: a percentage of the video height (`"8%"`, `"85%"`) or a WebVTT line number (`"0"`, `"-1"`)

position.description: Horizontal position as a percentage of the video width (`"5%"`, `"95%"`)

size.description: Width of the subtitle box as a percentage of the video width
